title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Hokkaido, shy fifteen-year-old Sawako Kuronuma is shunned because classmates think she looks like the ghost girl from The Ring and spread rumors that she can curse people. When popular, kind Shota Kazehaya starts talking to her, she gradually makes real friends, Ayane and Chizuru, and a slow, gentle romance develops between her and Kazehaya over high school.
life_message: It holds up sincerity, patience and the courage to reach out to others as the path to friendship and love.

delivery.evidence: Sources praise the series but say nothing on delivery; message carried by Sawako's friendships (to verify).
delivery.note: Kindness and sincerity are shown through Sawako's slowly won friendships, while gossip and snap judgment are the rejected attitude.

winners_losers: Sincere, patient Sawako and the friends who see past appearances win; gossip and snap judgments lose. Sympathy goes to the misunderstood outsider.
